title: What a politician needs
header_line: My analysis of one book on an entrepreneur's life. Not a summary of the book. Not affiliated with or endorsed by the author or publisher.

lines.text: When you ask for something from an official, what do they need from you?

I said that a company that sells a service worldwide is dealing with every government in the world. If he pulls a satellite signal down in his country, the company pays taxes there and he pays taxes there. They are doing political lobbying in every country.
You as entrepreneurs are going to have to understand how that all works, I said, and turned it into a learning lesson.

A student asked: what are the interests and needs of a politician, so you can have influence? Impact. If you do a needs assessment for a politician, what are the talking points you hit, as you would speak differently to an engineer?

I said: they want to be elected. They want to grow their constituents and their pool of favourable voters. So go through a checklist. First, understand the political platform of a senator: what they are running on.

When a campaign manager forms a platform, he picks the strengths: education, technology, agriculture because the family comes from it. They lead with those industries and take positions on their problems and solutions.

groups.heading: They sample, and they have a team

lines.text: They sample the industry, I said. They sit with the chamber of commerce and ask what frustrates them. The cattle people say: the last government cut our subsidies from fifteen percent to five, and we want them back. Another group wants subsidies on imported fertilizer.

They do a needs assessment in each industry where they are strong, then formulate a plan. That is when the lies come, to be blunt, I said: people talk about things they have no control over, with no commitment. The more granular a senator is about solutions, with a team, the more credible.

A student said: they are not individuals, they're a conduit of information. I said: a lot of people assume one person calls the shots. They have whole teams, different industries feeding them information, and someone to say: this is your position on this issue.
What would a needs assessment of the person you want to influence say?

exercise.title: Five minutes
steps: Write what they are running on or responsible for.
Write the three industries they care about.
Write the problems those industries have that you could help with.
Write who is on their team that you could reach first.

check.q: What did I say politicians want?
choices: To be elected and to grow their constituents

check.q: What did I tell you to understand first?
What did a student call politicians?

recap: Learn what the person you want to influence needs. Their platform comes first.
